correctness.rationale: The normalized orbit consists of exactly 28 integral cyclotomic vectors and passes the quartic restriction-square identities. A complete 378-pair resultant norm sieve, exceptional-prime tests at 29,43,71, and characteristic restrictions prove all 28 remain distinct for every odd prime other than 7. The 28-bitangent theorem ensures exhaustion. Exact six Galois permutations yield the stated Frobenius profiles and a six-cycle forces the full splitting field. Standalone SymPy verifier with captured VERIFY_OK is embedded. Inputs and computational bounds are fixed and exhaustive.
